# accrete

> Open source and self-hosted: you deploy it to your own Cloudflare account. It is not a hosted service.
> Agents on Cloudflare Durable Objects build the tools they need once, in a short-lived container, then run them in Worker isolates. A repeat run uses 0 container-seconds.

## Claim
After a tool is in the registry, a repeat of the same task uses 0 container-seconds. Disproved if any repeat run uses the container.

## How it works
1. A task runs in a workspace Durable Object. File steps run in an isolate.
2. A tool step looks up the tool in the registry (Durable Object + R2). A hit runs the stored bundle in a Worker Loader isolate with no network and no bindings.
3. A miss starts the builder container. It installs the npm package, bundles it with esbuild, and stops.
4. The bundle must print the same output as the native tool on a check case before it is stored by content hash.

Tool contract: run({ args, files }) -> { stdout, files }

## Evidence
- /status.json: proven, unproven and disproven claims with receipts
- receipts/02-*.json: slice 2 gate receipts

## Limits
- npm tools that esbuild can bundle to plain JavaScript only
- no network, no secrets in built tools
- write API needs a bearer token; demo actions run only on localhost
